golemarmor.configuration.title: Iron Golem Armor Config
golemarmor.configuration.ironGolems.tool: Armor, immunities and creeper hunting for iron golems.
golemarmor.configuration.ironGolems.play: Only buff golems built by players. Golems spawned by villages and villagers stay vanilla, so iron farms behave normally.
golemarmor.configuration.ironGolems.stat: Armor, armor toughness and bonus health.

Armor points added on top of vanilla's 0.
15 matches a full iron set.

Reduces how much big hits break through armor.
8 matches full diamond, 12 full netherite.

Extra max health on top of vanilla's 100.
Raising it heals golems by the increase. Keep it low on servers with many iron farms, since it slows cramming.
golemarmor.configuration.ironGolems.immu:
Off: vanilla.
No Afterburn: stop burning as soon as they leave fire or lava, but still take damage while in it.
Full: no damage from fire, lava, burning, magma or fireballs. Breaks lava and fire iron farms.
Golems can't be poisoned. Turning this on cures golems that already are.
No damage from standing on magma blocks. Breaks magma-floor iron farms.
No damage from cactus or sweet berry bushes.
Golems don't freeze in powder snow.
golemarmor.configuration.ironGolems.cree: Let iron golems attack creepers, while keeping villagers out of the blast.
Golems attack creepers, which vanilla golems ignore.

Leave a creeper alone while a villager or wandering trader is within this many blocks of it, and back off if one walks into range mid-fight.
Doubled for charged creepers. 0 = always attack.
A creeper blast reaches 6 blocks, 12 when charged.
golemarmor.configuration.snowGolems.tool: Armor, immunities, snow trails and special snowballs for snow golems.
golemarmor.configuration.snowGolems.snow:
Snow golems leave snow layers as they walk, like vanilla. Trails still need the mobGriefing gamerule.
Turn off to keep paths and builds clear.
golemarmor.configuration.snowGolems.stat: Armor points added on top of vanilla's 0.
Reduces how much big hits break through armor.
golemarmor.configuration.snowGolems.immu: No damage from rain or water.

Off: vanilla.
No Afterburn: stop burning as soon as they leave fire or lava, but still take damage while in it.
Full: no damage from fire, lava, burning, magma or fireballs, and no melting in hot biomes like deserts and the Nether.
Snow golems can't be poisoned. Turning this on cures golems that already are.
No damage from standing on magma blocks.
No damage from cactus or sweet berry bushes.
golemarmor.configuration.snowGolems.snow: Chances for snow golems to throw special snowballs.

Chance per throw of a yellow snowball, which gives poison and nausea for 5 seconds.
0 = never, 1 = every throw.

Chance per throw of a rock-filled snowball, which deals 1 damage and extra knockback.
Yellow is rolled first, so if the two chances add up to more than 1, rock only gets what's left.
